## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-fascicle sub-commentary by [智周](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E5%91%A8) (678–733) on Kuījī's [KR6n0029](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0029) *Chéng wéishí lùn zhǎngzhōng shūyào* (T43n1831). Preserved in the *Xuzangjing* (X49n0810). The text glosses Kuījī's compendious presentation of the topical-doctrinal organisation of the *Chéng wéishí lùn*, providing additional citations from the master treatise itself ([KR6n0016](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0016)) and from the lemma-by-lemma [KR6n0026](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0026) *shùjì*.

**Abstract**

The text is one of [智周](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E5%91%A8)'s several short sub-commentaries on Kuījī's Cí'ēn corpus, alongside [KR6n0036](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0036) *Chéng wéishí lùn liǎoyì dēng jì* on Huìzhāo's *liǎoyì dēng* and [KR6n0032](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6n/KR6n0032) *yǎnmì* on the master treatise itself. Together these works trace the second-generation Cí'ēn reading of T1585: where Kuījī's commentaries set out the basic doctrinal framework, Zhìzhōu's sub-commentaries refine technical details and resolve emerging interpretive disputes within the school.

The dating bracket (700–733) follows Zhìzhōu's productive teaching period.
